day1_strata.title: Day 1: The Strata's Greeting
day1_strata.step0_dialogue: Eyes open, traveler. You’re standing on Oakhaven-Station. Don't look for the sky—look at the ground. You're standing on ten civilizations that thought they were 'the final one.' They weren't. They’re just ore now. If you want to eat, you need to dig. Grab this pickaxe. It’s made of recycled hull-plating from an old star-liner. It has more history than you do.
day1_strata.step1_activity: Goal: Use `!mine` 10 times to scavenge the shallow strata.
day1_strata.step2_dialogue: Not bad. You didn't break the tool. Most people from the 'Upper Strata' expect the ground to give up its riches for free. Here, we earn our right to the next day. Take these scraps to Elara. She’ll show you why we bother digging at all.

day2_alchemy.title: Day 2: The Alchemy of Decay
day2_alchemy.step0_dialogue: Thorek sent you? He’s blunt, but he’s right. He finds the bones; I turn them into life. Look at this 'dirt.' It’s actually ground-up circuitry and ancient silk. It’s rich, but it’s stubborn. It needs a Will to make it bloom. Are you here to watch things grow, or are you here to make them grow?
day2_alchemy.step1_activity: Goal: Plant crops using `!farm` 10 times in the techn-organic soil.
day2_alchemy.step2_choice: When you look at these ruins, what do you see?
day2_alchemy.choice_a_label: A tragedy of what was lost.
day2_alchemy.choice_a_response: Nostalgia is a poison, traveler. The past is just fertilizer.
day2_alchemy.choice_b_response: Good. You have the eyes of a sower.

day3_base.title: Day 3: Establishing the Base
day3_base.step0_req: Goal: Accumulate 500 Money and 2 Aether-Slag to prove your commitment.
day3_base.step1_activity: Goal: Buy your first House (The Starter Shack) using `!house shop`.
day3_base.step2_dialogue: A roof is a declaration. You’re telling The Strata that you aren't just passing through—you're part of the cycle now. But a village isn't just houses. It’s the energy that connects them. We need to look at the Nexus.

day4_will.title: Day 4: The Will to Life
day4_will.step0_dialogue: The Nexus is hungry, but the wilds around Oakhaven are restless. The creatures here... they aren't 'animals' like the old books say. They are the synthesis. Flesh, magic, and metal fused by The Shedding. They don't want your pity. They want a master or a challenge. Come. Let’s see if you can track the pulse of the wild.
day4_will.step1_activity: Goal: Hunt 10 times near the rusted perimeter using `!hunt`.
day4_will.step2_dialogue: You found one. A Dormant Core-Pet. It’s not 'broken,' it’s just waiting for a reason to move again. Tame it. It’s your shadow now—a reminder that life overcomes even the silence of the machine.

day5_odds.title: Day 5: The Wisdom of the Odds
day5_odds.description: Introduction to GambleBot and the Casino.
day5_odds.step0_dialogue: Bzzzt— Greetings, Unit-Player! You look... exhausted. Toil, toil, toil. Do you think the universe rewards hard work? Error: Correlation not found! The Zenith fell because they tried to control the outcome. I am here to remind you that the dice are the only honest gods left. Care to embrace the chaos?
day5_odds.step2_dialogue: Win or lose, the wheel keeps spinning. That is the 'Amor Fati,' traveler. Love the roll, not the prize. By the way, my sensors are picking up a frequency... something old. Something... 'clean.' It’s coming from the horizon. Probably just a glitch. Forget I mentioned it.

day6_contribution.title: Day 6: The Great Contribution
day6_contribution.step0_dialogue: It’s time. The Aether-Root Nexus—the engine-tree in the center of town—is sputtering. If it dies, the village goes cold. If it thrives, we grow. We don't have a 'Chosen One' to fix it. We have us. Bring everything you’ve gathered. Let’s see if this generation has the grit to fuel the machine.
day6_contribution.step1_req: Goal: Donate 5 Aether-Slag and 5 Neon-Wheat to the Village Power Grid.

day7_sprout.title: Day 7: The First Sprout (The Beacon)
day7_sprout.step0_event: The Nexus surges! The Aether-Root glows with a brilliant, terrifying blue light. But the sudden energy draw has awakened an ancient defense mechanism in the lower strata.
day7_sprout.step1_boss: Goal: Defend the Nexus with your pet against The Rusted Custodian.
day7_sprout.step2_dialogue_team:
*Thorek*: It’s holding! The engine is humming.

*Elara*: Look at the roots... they're turning silver. It’s beautiful.

*Irian*: But it’s loud. We just screamed into the dark, and the world might scream back.

*GambleBot*: Probability of being noticed by 'The Restoration': 99.9%. The game just got interesting.
day7_sprout.step3_dialogue_unknown:
*Static-filled Transmission* : ...Signal detected. Sector 4-B. Oakhaven-Station confirmed active. Initiate 'Reclamation' protocol. The children are playing with matches again... it's time to bring back the order.

[SEASON 0 COMPLETE. WAIT FOR SEASON 1: THE RESTORATION]
